name: Hebrew
notes: Modern Israeli Hebrew, the abjad. Normally written UNVOCALIZED → full task is vowel restoration; all three core layers now in place. PHASE 1: niqqud→IPA segmental g2p on VOCALIZED input, 87.1% folded vs en.wiktionary vocalized→a=IL IPA (2561w, single-source) — bgdkpt dagesh (בּ=b/ב=v…), ⟨ש⟩ shin/sin, ⟨ו⟩ shuruk/holam-male, patach genuvah, mater lectionis. PHASE 2: a SENTENCE-LEVEL neural nakdan (phonemizeHebrewNeural) restoring niqqud→Phase-1 g2p, register-balanced for modern text (×5 oversample of the CC-BY-SA modern subset + targeted archaic-suppression mask) — 86.4% word-exact / 95.6% per-consonant on held-out modern running text; trained on the permissive Nakdimon subset. NUMBERS: gendered cardinal compositor (feminine citation, מֵאָה fem vs אֶלֶף/מִילְיוֹן masc multipliers, duals, decimals). Restoration ceiling (sheva-na free variation, context-free homographs, modern mater/dagesh OOD) is a characterized cap. Outstanding: an INDEPENDENT modern-Hebrew IPA referee (distinct from Wiktionary) to reach ✅.
